description: Returns a short-lived link to the Stripe billing portal for the person to open in their browser, where they can change plan, update a card or buy send packs. This is the only billing tool: you never change plans or buy anything yourself. Free; changes nothing. The link expires, so get a fresh one when needed and do not store it. Requires API key scope: account.
name: billing_portal_link
title: Billing portal link
